scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @nexo/shared build && pnpm --filter @nexo/core build && concurrently -k -n CORE,RENDERER,ELECTRON "pnpm --filter @nexo/core dev" "pnpm --filter @nexo/desktop dev:renderer" "wait-on tcp:5173 && pnpm --filter @nexo/desktop dev:electron"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @nexo/shared build && pnpm --filter @nexo/browser-agent build && pnpm --filter @nexo/core build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.browser:stability: pnpm --filter @nexo/shared build && pnpm --filter @nexo/browser-agent build && pnpm --filter @nexo/core build && node scripts/browser-stability.mjs
scripts.eval:intents: pnpm --filter @nexo/shared build && pnpm --filter @nexo/core build && node scripts/eval-intents.mjs
scripts.eval:agent:model: pnpm --filter @nexo/shared build && pnpm --filter @nexo/core build && node scripts/eval-agent-model-backed.mjs
scripts.eval:models: pnpm --filter @nexo/shared build && pnpm --filter @nexo/core build && node tests/model-evals/run-model-benchmark.mjs
scripts.package:win: pnpm --filter @nexo/shared build && pnpm --filter @nexo/browser-agent build && pnpm --filter @nexo/core build && pnpm --filter @nexo/desktop package:win && node scripts/verify-installer.mjs
